text:
deploy-bot: rollout done: release=2026.4.1 region=us-east-1 commit=def5678. starting postdeploy smoke: prefill, kvprobe, embed-synth.

lio: noticing a small but steady rise in prefill queue latency immediately after cutover. p95 trending 180ms -> 310ms over 3m.

carmen: getting a couple `upstream timeout` logs from prefill-3: `timeout after 60s while connecting to storage` — looks transient.

devon: runbook says hold if prefill p95 >250ms for >5m. can someone kick off a targeted synthetic to isolate prefill-3?

oncall-ash: pinned embed-route back to v2026.3.8 in us-east-1 to drain canary: `rwctl pin-route embed-route v2026.3.8 --ttl 1800s --reason "postdeploy prefill p95"`

deploy-bot: routing pin applied by oncall-ash. canary traffic set to 0% for embed-route in us-east-1. continuing smoke checks.

lio: ran a direct curl to prefill-3: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{time_total}\n" https://prefill-3.us-east-1.prefill.redwood/api/warmup` -> 0.27s. other hosts ~0.09s.

carmen: scaling event shows prefill-3 under memory pressure + GC spikes during rollout window. autoscaler added a replacement but it hadn't fully joined before canary.

devon: suggests adding a brief prefill warmup step to the release checklist to avoid cold-hosts hitting traffic during rollout. open RN-4562.

oncall-ash: i've resumed canary at 10% with pin still in place; monitoring for 10m.

deploy-bot: canary resume: 10% for 10m. no new 5xxs reported in the last 2m.

lio: after pin + letting replacement host warm, p95 back to ~95ms on checks. prefill-3 GC settled.

carmen: will follow up on autoscaler tuning and add heap safety margin.

devon: will add the warmup step to the release playbook and a nightly synthetic that exercises prefill host join.

oncall-ash: marking for observation; pin TTL to expire unless re-applied.

deploy-bot: observation complete: no regressions observed during hold window. recommend documenting the warmup requirement in release notes.

lio: assigning postmortem RN-4562 to carmen. thanks team. :thumbsup:
